props.name: disabled
props.comment: Never fetch. Defaults to `true` outside production.

props.name: fetchOptions
props.comment: Read at each check. `cache: "no-store"` always overrides it.

props.name: interval
props.comment: Milliseconds between checks. Defaults to one hour.

props.name: notification
props.comment: Shown once a new build is found. Defaults to `<ApplicationUpdatedNotification />`.

props.name: onNewVersionAvailable
props.comment: Called once, when the first change is seen.

props.name: url
props.comment: Page to fingerprint. Defaults to `${location.origin}/index.html`, read at each check.
